## Loading packages and files ##

Refer to *2026-05_EPIC-PD_Validation_v2.Rmd* for the original code by Rashmi

```{r include = F}
#Setting the working directory
here::i_am("EPIC-PD_Validation_DL.Rmd")

#Loading packages
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(sjPlot)
library(broom)
library(car)

#Loading files
input_RM <- readRDS("all_visits_df_2313patients_after_filtering_age_at_visit.rds") #Merged proteomic and clinical data
me_v1 <- readRDS("module_eigengenes_visit_1.rds") #Module eigenproteins (Visit/Timepoint 1)
me_v2 <- readRDS("ME_of_relabelled_modules_visit2.rds") #Module eigenproteins (Visit/Timepoint 2)
me_v3 <- readRDS("ME_of_relabelled_modules_visit3.rds") #Module eigenproteins (Visit/Timepoint 3)
protein_list <- read.csv("trackingPD_protein-check.csv") #Laura's protein list of interest
analyte_info <- read.csv("analyte_info.csv") #Aptamer metadata
```

## Data pre-processing ##

```{r}
#Cleaning the protein list of interest
protein_list <- protein_list %>%
  
  #Matching the protein list with mappable probe IDs
  left_join(
    analyte_info %>% 
      dplyr::select("AptName", "EntrezGeneSymbol") %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        "protein.symbol" = "EntrezGeneSymbol",
        "probe.id" = "AptName"
      ),
    by = "protein.symbol",
    relationship = "many-to-many" #Same Entrez symbols can have different probe IDs
  ) %>% 
  
  #Renaming the module names using a common naming system
  mutate(module = case_when(
    str_detect(module, "red") ~ "MEred",
    str_detect(module, "black") ~ "MEblack",
    str_detect(module, "blue") ~ "MEblue",
    str_detect(module, "brown") ~ "MEbrown",
    str_detect(module, "turquoise") ~ "MEturquoise"
  )) %>%
  
  distinct(probe.id, .keep_all = T)
```

```{r}
#Defining the variables of interest
module_colours <- c(
  "MEbrown", 
  "MEblue", 
  "MEturquoise", 
  "MEgreen", 
  "MEyellow", 
  "MEblack", 
  "MEred"
  )

clinical_outcomes <- c(
  "moca_total", "moca_total_adj", "seman_flu_score", 
  "updrs_i", "updrs_ii", "updrs_iii", "updrs_iv", 
  "pdq8_total", "ess_total", "eq5d_index", 
  "rbd_total", "gcsi_total", "leeds_anx_total", "hoehn_and_yahr_stage", "nmss_sleep"
)

ldopa_vars <- c(
  "ldopa_bin",
  "ledd_total"
)

#Merging and wrangling the eigenprotein values into a single dataframe
me_all <- bind_rows(me_v1, me_v2, me_v3) %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(module_colours)) %>%
  mutate(
    
    #Changing 'SampleId' to the common/matchable 'PatientId' format
    PatientId = str_sub(rownames(.), end = -4), 
    
    #Adopting the same visit_number system as the main input dataframe
    visit_number = rep(c(1, 4, 7), each = 757)
    
  )

#Merging the eigenproteins with the main input data
input_RM_long <- left_join(me_all, input_RM, by = c("PatientId", "visit_number")) %>%
  
  #Selecting the main variables for analysis
  dplyr::select(
    
    #Demographic data
    PatientId, visit_number, age_at_visit, gender, disease_duration_diag,
    
    #Eigenprotein values
    all_of(module_colours), 
    
    #Clinical outcome variables
    all_of(clinical_outcomes),
    
    #Proteins of interest
    all_of(protein_list$probe.id),
    
    #Levodopa variables
    all_of(levodopa_vars)
    
  ) %>%
  
  #Setting the appropriate levels for factors
  mutate(
    visit_number = factor(visit_number, levels = c("1", "4", "7")),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("Female", "Male")),
    ldopa_bin = factor(ldopa_bin, c("0", "1"))
  ) %>%
  
  #Sorting by Participant ID
  group_by(PatientId) %>% arrange(PatientId)

#Specifying contrasts for type III ANOVA (lmer with interactions)
contrasts(input_RM_long$visit_number) <- contr.sum(3) #For 3 time points (1,4,7)
contrasts(input_RM_long$gender) <- contr.sum(2) #For 2 sex categories (F,M)
contrasts(input_RM_long$ldopa_bin) <- contr.sum(2) #For 2 levels in levodopa status (ON,OFF)
```

Note: 
 - *contr.sum()* sets contrasts such that the coefficients represent deviations from the grand mean, instead of a reference category
 - This is important for the ANOVA run on the interaction term (time) since visit_number has 3 factor-level time points [1,4,7]

## MIXED-EFFECT MODELS WITH clin_var ~ MEcolor ##

```{r}
#Function to run the mixed-effect model on all clinical variables of interest across all modules
clin_mlm_results <- list()

for(j in clinical_outcomes) {
  
  clin_lmer <- list()
  clin_results <- list()
  
  for(i in module_colours) {
    
    #Defining the model formula
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        j, "~", i, "*visit_number + age_at_visit + gender + (1|PatientId)"
      )
    )
    
    #Running the mixed-effect model
    clin_lmer[[i]] <- lmer(formula, data = input_RM_long)
    
    #Extracting the statistics from the main effect (module eigenprotein)
    main <- summary(clin_lmer[[i]])$coefficients %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
      filter(term == i)
    
    #Running ANOVA on the interaction term (time)
    interaction <- anova(clin_lmer[[i]], type = 3) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
      filter(term == paste0(i, ":visit_number")) 
    
    #Building the results table
    clin_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      clin_var = j,
      module = i,
      beta = main$Estimate,
      se = main$`Std. Error`,
      t = main$`t value`,
      p_main = main$`Pr(>|t|)`,
      F = interaction$`F value`,
      p_interaction = interaction$`Pr(>F)`
    )
    
  }
  
  #Compiling the results
  clin_mlm_results[[j]] <- bind_rows(clin_results)
  
}

#Compiling the results with BH-adjusted p-values
clin_mlm_results <- bind_rows(clin_mlm_results) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_main = p.adjust(p_main, method = "BH"),
    FDR_interaction = p.adjust(p_interaction, method = "BH")
  )
```

```{r}
#Saving the output
write.csv(clin_mlm_results, "trackingPD_clin_mlm.csv", row.names = F)
```

Re-running the lmer with levodopa variables (dichotomized & continuous) as covariates:

```{r}
clin_ldopa_mlm_results <- list()

for (j in clinical_outcomes) {
  
  for (cov in ldopa_vars) {
    
    clin_lmer <- list()
    clin_results <- list()
    
    for (i in module_colours) {
      
      #Defining the model formula
      formula <- as.formula(
        paste0(
          j, "~", i, "*visit_number + age_at_visit + gender + ",
          cov, " + (1|PatientId)"
        )
      )
      
      #Running the mixed-effect model
      clin_lmer[[i]] <- lmer(formula, data = input_RM_long)
      
      #Extracting the main effect (module eigenprotein)
      main <- summary(clin_lmer[[i]])$coefficients %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
        filter(term == i)
      
      #Running ANOVA on the interaction term (time)
      interaction <- anova(clin_lmer[[i]], type = 3) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
        filter(term == paste0(i, ":visit_number"))
      
      #Building the results table
      clin_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
        clin_var = j,
        model = cov,
        module = i,
        beta = main$Estimate,
        se = main$`Std. Error`,
        t = main$`t value`,
        p_main = main$`Pr(>|t|)`,
        F = interaction$`F value`,
        p_interaction = interaction$`Pr(>F)`
      )
      
    }
    
    #Compiling results for each clinical outcome and model
    clin_ldopa_mlm_results[[j]][[cov]] <- bind_rows(clin_results)
    
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Compiling results from both levodopa models (dichotomized & continuous)
clin_ldopa_mlm_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  clin_ldopa_mlm_results,
  function(model_list, outcome) {
    purrr::imap_dfr(
      model_list,
      function(df, covariate) {
        df %>%
          mutate(model = covariate)
      }
    )
  },
  .id = "clin_var"
)

#Calculating BH-adjusted p-values
clin_ldopa_mlm_results <- clin_ldopa_mlm_results %>%
  group_by(clin_var, model) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_main = p.adjust(p_main, method = "BH"),
    FDR_interaction = p.adjust(p_interaction, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    clin_var, model, module, everything()
  )
```

```{r}
#Saving the outputs
write.csv(
  clin_ldopa_mlm_results %>% filter(model == "ldopa_bin"), 
  "trackingPD_clin_ldopabin_mlm.csv", 
  row.names = F
)

write.csv(
  clin_ldopa_mlm_results %>% filter(model == "ledd_total"), 
  "trackingPD_clin_ldopadose_mlm.csv", 
  row.names = F
)
```

## MIXED-EFFECT MODELS WITH clin_var ~ probe_id ##

```{r}
#Function to run the mixed-effect model on all clinical variables of interest across all select proteins 
prot_mlm_results <- list()

for(j in clinical_outcomes) {
  
  prot_lmer <- list()
  prot_results <- list()
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(protein_list)) {
    
    probe <- protein_list$probe.id[i]
    
    #Defining the model formula
    formula <- as.formula(
      paste0(
        j, "~", probe, "*visit_number + age_at_visit + gender + (1|PatientId)"
      )
    )
    
    #Running the mixed-effect model
    prot_lmer[[i]] <- lmer(formula, data = input_RM_long)
    
    #Extracting the statistics from the main effect (module eigenprotein)
    main <- summary(prot_lmer[[i]])$coefficients %>% 
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
      filter(term == probe)
    
    #Running ANOVA on the interaction term (time)
    interaction <- anova(prot_lmer[[i]], type = 3) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
      filter(term == paste0(probe, ":visit_number"))
    
    #Building the results table
    prot_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
      clin_var = j,
      probe.id = probe,
      beta = main$Estimate,
      se = main$`Std. Error`,
      t = main$`t value`,
      p_main = main$`Pr(>|t|)`,
      F = interaction$`F value`,
      p_interaction = interaction$`Pr(>F)`
    )
    
  }
  
  #Compiling the results
  prot_mlm_results[[j]] <- bind_rows(prot_results)
  
}

#Compiling the results with BH-adjusted p-values
prot_mlm_results <- bind_rows(prot_mlm_results) %>%
  left_join(protein_list %>% dplyr::select(probe.id, protein.symbol), by = "probe.id") %>%
  mutate(
    probe_id = probe.id,
    protein_symbol = protein.symbol,
    FDR_main = p.adjust(p_main, method = "BH"),
    FDR_interaction = p.adjust(p_interaction, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  
  #Reorganising column order for clarity
  dplyr::select(clin_var, protein_symbol, probe_id, everything(), -probe.id, -protein.symbol) 
```

```{r}
#Saving the output
write.csv(prot_mlm_results, "trackingPD_prot_mlm.csv", row.names = F)
```

Re-running the lmer with levodopa variables (dichotomized & continuous) as covariates:

```{r}
prot_ldopa_mlm_results <- list()

for (j in clinical_outcomes) {
  
  for (cov in ldopa_vars) {
    
    prot_lmer <- list()
    prot_results <- list()
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(protein_list)) {
      
      probe <- protein_list$probe.id[i]
      
      #Defining the model formula
      formula <- as.formula(
        paste0(
          j, "~", probe, "*visit_number + age_at_visit + gender + ", cov, " + (1|PatientId)"
        )
      )
      
      #Running the mixed-effect model
      prot_lmer[[i]] <- lmer(formula, data = input_RM_long)
      
      #Extracting the main effect (protein)
      main <- summary(prot_lmer[[i]])$coefficients %>% 
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
        filter(term == probe)
      
      #Running ANOVA on the interaction term (time)
      interaction <- anova(prot_lmer[[i]], type = 3) %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        rownames_to_column(var = "term") %>%
        filter(term == paste0(probe, ":visit_number"))
      
      #Building the results table
      prot_results[[i]] <- data.frame(
        clin_var = j,
        model = cov,
        probe.id = probe,
        beta = main$Estimate,
        se = main$`Std. Error`,
        t = main$`t value`,
        p_main = main$`Pr(>|t|)`,
        F = interaction$`F value`,
        p_interaction = interaction$`Pr(>F)`
      )
      
    }
    
    #Compiling results for each clinical outcome and model
    prot_ldopa_mlm_results[[j]][[cov]] <- bind_rows(prot_results)
    
  }
}
```

```{r}
#Compiling results from both models using purrr
prot_ldopa_mlm_results <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  prot_ldopa_mlm_results,
  function(model_list, outcome) {

    purrr::imap_dfr(
      model_list,
      function(df, covariate) {
        df %>%
          mutate(model = covariate)
      }
    )
  },
  .id = "clin_var"
)

#Adding protein annotations and BH-adjusted p-values
prot_ldopa_mlm_results <- prot_ldopa_mlm_results %>%
  left_join(
    protein_list %>% 
      dplyr::select(probe.id, protein.symbol),
    by = "probe.id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    probe_id = probe.id,
    protein_symbol = protein.symbol
  ) %>%
  
  #Performing separate BH corrections for each model
  group_by(clin_var, model) %>%
  mutate(
    FDR_main = p.adjust(p_main, method = "BH"),
    FDR_interaction = p.adjust(p_interaction, method = "BH")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  #Reorganising column order for clarity
  dplyr::select(
    clin_var, model, protein_symbol, probe_id,
    everything(), -probe.id, -protein.symbol
  )
```

```{r}
#Saving the outputs
write.csv(
  prot_ldopa_mlm_results %>% filter(model == "ldopa_bin"), 
  "trackingPD_prot_ldopabin_mlm.csv", 
  row.names = F
)

write.csv(
  prot_ldopa_mlm_results %>% filter(model == "ledd_total"), 
  "trackingPD_prot_ldopadose_mlm.csv", 
  row.names = F
)
```
